justification: The level awards one point on victory and the tightened win test asks for at least one, so the test is satisfied by exactly the frames that satisfied it before. A tightened victory condition that a winning frame already meets changes nothing about which sequences win; it is the boundary case of the operator, and it is on the paper so that an examinee cannot read 'win_tighten' as a synonym for 'unsolvable'.
notes: The fifth wrapper operator, exercised at its no-op boundary. There is no unsolvable win_tighten item because an A2-family level has a single binary victory test, so any threshold above one would be unsolvable for a reason no certificate in the grammar states.
